title: Circuit Current Simulation
description: An interactive simulation demonstrating electric current flow through a circuit with a battery and resistor. Users can switch between conventional current and electron flow views, and adjust voltage and resistance to see how current speed changes according to Ohm's Law (I = V/R).
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Electric Current
Ohm's Law
Circuits
Voltage
Resistance
Electron Flow
Conventional Current
Physics
Electricity
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of circuit current
Explore circuit current through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of circuit current to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on circuit current
